==Acquisition==
This effect activates when you pick up [[Saidra's Ashes]].

==Related skills==
*{{skill icon|Mighty Was Vorizun}}
*{{skill icon|Protective Was Kaolai}}

==Notes==
* This skill can only be used in [[Sparkfly Swamp]], which is the only place one can find [[Saidra's Ashes]]
* Its skill icon is visually identical to those of Ritualist item spells, although any profession can find and use her ashes.
{{anomaly|This skill affects all [[Ally|allies]], although the description only mentions party members.}}

== Trivia ==

{{spoiler|''[[Guild Wars Prophecies]]''}}
* [[Saidra]] was one of the members of the [[Shining Blade]] in the Prophecies [[campaign]]. She died protecting the party from the [[Mursaat]] attack in the [[Ice Caves of Sorrow]] mission.
